name: Sasanami Ace
source:
Since he doesn't speak much, Ace leaves an impression of being cold, but his passion for tennis is strong. He's an extremely hardworking person and leads a stoic life. However, when it comes to things unrelated to tennis, Ace is somewhat absentminded. There are many people who say that they can't leave him to his own devices because of this.

[Translation of his [URL=http://rejetweb.jp/moshikami/character/ace.html]official website profile[/URL].]
